args.sql:
WITH robot_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.botdetreg AS robot_id,
        rd.modelseriesval AS model_series,
        SUM(op.progcyclecount) AS total_program_cycles,
        SUM(op.cycletimesecval) / COUNT(op.operreg) AS avg_cycle_time,
        COUNT(DISTINCT op.currprogval) AS unique_programs,
        op.totopshrval AS operation_time
    FROM 
        robot_details rd
    JOIN 
        operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    GROUP BY 
        rd.botdetreg, rd.modelseriesval, op.totopshrval
),
robot_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.*,
        (total_program_cycles / SUM(total_program_cycles) OVER (PARTITION BY model_series)) AS efficiency_score
    FROM 
        robot_metrics rm
),
robot_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        re.*, 
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY model_series ORDER BY efficiency_score DESC) AS efficiency_rank
    FROM 
        robot_efficiency re
)
SELECT 
    rr.robot_id,
    rr.model_series,
    rr.total_program_cycles AS tpc,
    rr.avg_cycle_time,
    rr.unique_programs,
    rr.operation_time,
    rr.efficiency_score AS oce,
    rr.efficiency_rank
FROM 
    robot_ranking rr
WHERE 
    rr.total_program_cycles > (SELECT AVG(total_program_cycles) FROM robot_metrics)
ORDER BY 
    rr.efficiency_rank ASC;
